witness.quote: No person shall stand or park a vehicle in a roadway other than parallel with the edge of the roadway headed in the direction of lawful traffic movement.
witness.reason: The fixed parallel-parking task directly supports observing the two orientation requirements on a one-way roadway.
required_context: Do not introduce numerical orientation tolerances or curb-distance limits.

witness.subject_reason: The available motor-vehicle driver can be the person responsible for standing or parking; the law is not limited to a currently driving person.
